info.title: KodaStore API
info.description:
REST API for the KodaStore e-commerce platform: OTP-based authentication, users, products and reviews, carts, orders, wishlists, admin operations and Stripe webhook handling.

Authentication uses an HTTP-only JWT cookie named `token`, set by `POST /auth/login`.

Successful responses share the shape `{ success, message, data }`.

tags.description: Registration, login, OTP verification, password reset and profile

post.summary: Register a new user and send OTP for email verification
post.description: Stores the pending registration together with a 6-digit OTP (valid for 5 minutes) and emails the code. The account is only created after `POST /auth/verify-otp`.

400.description: Validation error, or the email is already taken

post.summary: Verify OTP for email confirmation and create the user

200.description: Email verified and user created (password omitted)

400.description: Invalid or expired OTP, email already verified, or validation error

post.summary: Login user and set JWT cookie
post.description: Sets an HTTP-only `token` cookie (SameSite=Strict, 24 h; `Secure` in production). In production, unverified users are rejected with 400.

400.description: Validation error, or email not verified (production only)
Invalid or expired OTP, or validation error

get.description: The user's wishlist is populated with full product documents.

post.summary: Logout user and clear JWT cookie

get.description: Each user's wishlist is populated with full product documents.

400.description: Validation error, or a user with this email already exists

patch.summary: Update the authenticated user's own account
patch.description: Users can only update their own account: the `id` must match the logged-in user, otherwise 403 is returned (this applies to admins too).

403.description: The id does not belong to the authenticated user

get.summary: Get paginated active products with filters
get.description: Only products with `isActive: true` are returned. `category` is matched in lower case.

post.description: At least one image file is required (multipart field `image`).

400.description: Validation error, or no image was uploaded

get.description: Only active products are searched. `text` uses a MongoDB text index. Results are sorted by `-createdAt` unless `sort` is given. Note that this endpoint's pagination block is a top-level field, not inside `data`.

delete.description: Also deletes the product's images from Cloudinary.

put.summary: Update product details and images (admin only)
put.description: Only the fields that are sent are changed. `imagesToDelete` removes images (by `public_id`) from the product and from Cloudinary; new files in `image` are appended. A product must always keep at least one image.

400.description: Validation error, or the update would leave the product without images

get.summary: Get list of reviews for a product
get.description: Each review's `user` is populated with `_id` and `username`.

post.summary: Add a review to a product
post.description: Each user can review a product only once.

201.description: Review added; returns the updated product

409.description: User has already reviewed this product

delete.summary: Delete a product review by review ID
delete.description: Allowed for the review's author or an admin.

200.description: Review deleted; returns the recalculated rating summary

403.description: Not the review's author and not an admin

get.description: An empty cart is created on first access.

post.description: Quantities accumulate: adding an existing product increases its quantity, up to available stock.

200.description: Item added; returns the updated cart

400.description: Validation error, or not enough stock available

patch.summary: Update quantity of an item in cart
patch.description: Sets the quantity (does not add to it). Must not exceed available stock.

200.description: Quantity updated; returns the updated cart

404.description: Cart, cart item, or product not found

200.description: Item removed; returns the updated cart

404.description: Cart or cart item not found

delete.description: Also removes any applied coupon. Returns the raw cart document, not the formatted cart view.

post.description: Coupon codes are case-sensitive and defined server-side: `SAVE10`, `SAVE20`, `SAVE50`, `SAVE80` (percentage discounts) and `OFF50` (fixed 50 off).

200.description: Coupon applied; returns the updated cart

400.description: Code is missing, invalid or expired

200.description: Coupon removed; returns the updated cart

400.description: No coupon is applied to the cart

post.summary: Create a new order from the current user's cart
post.description:
Builds the order from the user's cart inside a single transaction: stock is checked and decremented, the cart and its coupon are cleared, and the cart discount is copied onto the order. The shipping address is added to the user's saved addresses if it is new. A confirmation email is sent.

- `cash`: order is created as `confirmed` with `paymentStatus: pending`.
- `stripe`: a PaymentIntent (currency EGP) is created; the response includes its `clientSecret` so the client can complete payment. The Stripe webhook later marks the order paid.

201.description: Order created (cash) or created pending payment (stripe)

400.description: Unsupported payment method, missing shipping address, empty cart, or insufficient stock

404.description: User not found, or a product in the cart no longer exists

get.summary: Get paginated orders for current user with filters
get.description: Newest first. Responds with 404 when no orders match.

get.summary: Get order details by ID for current user

404.description: Order not found, or it belongs to another user

patch.summary: Cancel an order by ID for current user
patch.description: Only orders with status `pending` or `confirmed` can be cancelled. Sets `cancelledAt` and restores product stock.

400.description: Invalid ID, or the order is no longer cancellable

404.description: Order not found, or it belongs to another user

get.summary: Get paginated orders with filters (admin only)
get.description: Newest first. Each order's `user` is populated (see `OrderUserBasic`).

get.summary: Get order details by ID with user info (admin only)

patch.summary: Update order status and optionally add admin note (admin only)
patch.description:
Status can only move forward through this sequence: `pending` → `confirmed` → `processing` → `shipped` → `delivered` → `cancelled` → `returned`. Setting the same or an earlier status returns 400. Cancelling is only allowed from `pending` or `confirmed`, and `cancelled` → `returned` is rejected.

Side effects:
- `delivered`: sets `deliveredAt`; a pending cash payment becomes `paid`.
- `cancelled`: sets `cancelledAt`.
- `cancelled` / `returned`: product stock is restored and a `paid` payment becomes `refunded`.

A status-update email is sent to the customer; email failures are logged and do not fail the request.

200.description: Order status updated and notification email processed

400.description: Validation error, or the status change is not allowed

post.description: The first product creates the wishlist and responds with **201** and no `data`. Adding to an existing wishlist responds with **200** and the wishlist with `products` populated.

get.description: Revenue figures only count orders with `paymentStatus: paid`. `last7Days` counts all orders created in the last 7 days.
Only carts with at least one item. Users and products are populated.

post.description:
Called by Stripe, not by clients. The **raw** request body is verified against the `Stripe-Signature` header. Handled events:
- `payment_intent.succeeded`: order becomes `paid` / `confirmed`, `paidAt` is set.
- `payment_intent.payment_failed`: `paymentStatus` becomes `failed`.
- `payment_intent.canceled`: `paymentStatus` becomes `failed`, order `cancelled`, stock restored.

ApplyCouponRequest.description: No Joi validator on this route; the code is looked up in a server-side list.

topProducts.description: Top 5 by units sold (paid orders only)

result.description: Number of products in this page

data.description: `Order` for cash payments; `{ order, clientSecret }` for stripe payments
